;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**Overnight, protesters forcibly storm the [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[embassy]] in [[Santiago]] and [[Arson|set it on fire]] because of the [[Argentine government]]'s support for [[President of Chile|President]] [[Sebastián Piñera]]. Ambassador [[José Octavio Bordón]] is unharmed and now considering moving the embassy. ;Disasters and accidents
*[[Bushfires in Australia]]
**The bodies of three people killed by bushfires in [[Australia]] are found – two near [[Glen Innes, New South Wales|Glen Innes]], and one at [[Johns River, New South Wales|Johns River]] – as fires that have destroyed at least 150 houses continue to burn in eastern [[New South Wales]] and [[Queensland]]. [https://www.smh.com.au/national/nsw/nsw-bushfires-live-firefighters-to-assess-damage-amid-unprecedented-emergency-20191109-p538ye.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
